title: Discover and build a workflow Actor

goal.title: What should your Actor do?
goal.description: Describe the task and include any sample URL, location or search term in this prompt. The planner may ask for missing details.
goal.prefill: Visit https://apify.com/actors and produce a short source-backed brief about the platform.
goal.default: Visit https://apify.com/actors and produce a short source-backed brief about the platform.

mode.title: Plan or test
mode.description: Plan discovers and exports an untested workflow. Test runs trusted tools, or returns a review-required status for unfamiliar tools. Advanced reviewed workflows can be supplied via API.

generatedName.title: Generated Actor name
generatedName.description: Name for the generated project. Deployment may update an existing Actor with the same name.
